title: Tracker tmux
responsibility: Reads retained Tracker panes and guards terminal writes against pane, cursor, and provider changes.

inputs.name: TrackerTmuxAdapter.constructor.config
inputs.description: Controlled tmux executable and canonical Tracker node.

inputs.name: TrackerTmuxAdapter.scan.signal
inputs.description: Lifetime for the inventory and bounded pane reads.

inputs.name: TrackerTmuxAdapter.scan.names
inputs.description: Allowed session names. Defaults to the existing Tracker task-session names.

inputs.name: TrackerTmuxAdapter.inventory.signal
inputs.description: Lifetime for the socket inventory calls.

inputs.name: TrackerTmuxAdapter.nudge.input
inputs.description: Observed pane identity and cursor state, expected provider, and literal text.

inputs.name: TrackerTmuxAdapter.nudge.signal
inputs.description: Lifetime for the identity checks and guarded write.

inputs.name: trackerTmuxPane.raw
inputs.description: One line from the expected tmux pane format.

inputs.name: trackerTmuxPane.scope
inputs.type: { socket: string; runnerSocket: boolean; names: RegExp }
inputs.description: Socket identity, runner designation and accepted session names.

inputs.name: matchesTrackerTmuxPane.observed
inputs.description: Fresh pane observation on the configured socket.

inputs.name: matchesTrackerTmuxPane.expected
inputs.description: Identity, time and cursor from the planned nudge.

inputs.name: trackerTmuxKeys.paneId
inputs.description: Validated numeric tmux pane ID on the selected socket.

inputs.name: trackerTmuxKeys.message
inputs.description: Control-character-free message already checked by the caller.

outputs.name: TrackerTmuxAdapter.scan
outputs.description: Read the allowed pane layouts and capture their visible screens only when identity is stable.

outputs.name: TrackerTmuxAdapter.inventory
outputs.description: Read pane identity and timing without reading terminal output.

outputs.name: TrackerTmuxAdapter.nudge
outputs.description: Send literal keys and Enter only if the same pane still has the intended idle composer.

outputs.name: trackerPaneFormat
outputs.description: Tmux format for the stable pane fields used in revalidation.

outputs.name: trackerSessionName
outputs.description: The retained Tracker manual and managed tmux session naming rule.

outputs.name: trackerTmuxPane
outputs.description: Parse one safe tmux pane layout or omit it when the row cannot be verified.

outputs.name: matchesTrackerTmuxPane
outputs.description: Compare the observed pane identity, activity, creation time, and cursor to the intended target.

outputs.name: trackerTmuxKeys
outputs.description: Build the tmux command body with text escaped for literal input.

errors.name: TrackerHostProcessError
errors.description: The bounded host command could not produce a trustworthy response.
